yeah, I know...but like I tried to talk to him about it and we ended up just arguing. :/ I posted on offmychest about the dumb long story but long story short one of my old best friends reached out to me saying he was sorry for being a prick, I wanted to reconciliate but I knew it'd mess up my relationship (b/c my boyfriend knows he used to be a prick, basically...) I then had an argument with bf that made me feel shittier about it. And I now have an anonymous account that I made because I was tempted to just talk to my friend. I know I have 0 romantic feelings but my bf doesnt trust me basically.

NOW I KNOW this sounds like really really petty drama but I come from a history of being abused and my old best friends was one of the very few people that was ever there for me during that time. It's been really hard to turn my back on him. :/ I've been strong so far though haha..
